name: ThirsTea - Boba, Rolled Ice Cream
notes: 4 menu-photo boards. Photo 1 is an older printed board (Cafe Drinks, Chai, Iced Tea, Signature, Souffle Cake, Rolled Ice Cream, Toppings). Photos 2-3 are a current-looking digital TV menu with overlapping category names but different prices/flavor lists (ThirsTea Signature $6.00 vs photo 1's Signature $6.25; Iced Tea $5.00 vs $5.75; Chai $5.75/$5.25 vs $5.75/$5.50). Where categories overlapped, the digital board (photos 2-3) was treated as current and used; photo 1's older Signature/Iced Tea/Chai entries were dropped as superseded duplicates. Photo 1's unique categories (Cafe Drinks, Brewed Coffee, Souffle Cake, Rolled Ice Cream) were kept. Photo 4 is a promo poster with no prices printed; only its Cookies & Cream Milkshake (not found priced elsewhere) was added, without a price. The Frappe price and Slush price in photo 3 were partly cut off at the image edge ($5.x); Slush was read as $5.50 and Frappe's price was illegible and omitted rather than guessed. Multi-flavor same-price categories (e.g. Milk Tea, Smoothies) were recorded as one line item with the flavor list in the description, matching how single-price flavor menus are elsewhere transcribed. The 'Toppings'/'Health & Wellness Toppings'/'Milk Options'/'Sugar Options' lists in photo 1 are add-on modifiers and were omitted.
